business_problem: As order volume and service complexity grew, Deppon Express needed to lower communication cost, improve response speed, and deliver consistent service across many digital channels without overloading human agents.
solution_summary: Deppon Express built an online customer-service platform with Baidu AI Cloud to create a dual-track service model that combines automation with human escalation. The implementation paired Baidu Intelligent Customer Service, Baidu Keyue, and Deppon's online customer-service IM system so the company could standardize logistics-domain scripts, accumulate reusable Q&A knowledge, and expose the same service logic across more than ten customer touchpoints. Incoming questions from mini programs, the website, the mobile app, Alipay, Douyin, and other channels flow into the intelligent layer first, where routine intents are answered automatically and unresolved issues are handed to live agents with a shared knowledge context. The setup gives Deppon one service backbone for consistent logistics answers, faster response times, and lower transfer-to-human rates while preserving human support for complex requests.

solution_components.name: Baidu Intelligent Customer Service
solution_components.role: Handles first-line automated responses for routine logistics inquiries across digital channels.

solution_components.name: Baidu Keyue
solution_components.role: Provides the conversational layer that helps structure Deppon's intelligent online service workflows.

solution_components.name: Online Customer Service IM System
solution_components.role: Hosts Deppon's live-service interactions and receives escalations from the AI layer when human support is required.

solution_components.name: Logistics Knowledge Base
solution_components.role: Stores the domain-specific scripts and Q&A knowledge built from Deppon's logistics service scenarios.

data_flow: Questions from WeChat mini programs, the website, the app, Alipay, Douyin, and other service entries are routed into the intelligent customer-service layer. Routine intents are answered from Deppon's logistics knowledge base, while harder cases are transferred into the IM system for human follow-up with the same script and context foundation.
business_outcome: Deppon Express created a consistent omnichannel service model for logistics support, reduced manual handoffs, and improved customer-response efficiency while continuing to route complex cases to live agents.
